title: Murashige and Skoog (MS) Agar Preparation
author: Steven J Burgess
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xd8fi9w
materials: Murashige and Skoog Basal Salt medium

steps.title: Prepare MS Basal Medium
steps.instruction: Add Murashige and Skoog Basal Salt medium and 800 mL of dH2O to a 1L flask.

steps.title: Add Agar and Autoclave
steps.instruction: Add 7 g of Bacto Agar to the flask and autoclave the mixture.

steps.title: Adjust Volume and pH
steps.instruction: Bring the final volume to 1L with dH2O and adjust the pH to 5.7 using 2 N Potassium hydroxide (KOH).
